status: IFU top-level adapter scope complete; hardware residuals and out-of-scope consumer limits remain open

implementation.fetch_input_contract: FetchRequest validates the supplied raw halfword stream independently of build_window/Boundary/DUT observations, then binds instruction count, start/width, PC, slot, block, cross, end, prediction, FTQ, raw/output word, ISA class, RAS, jump offset, truncation and half/count markers. Carry high-half identity additionally requires an input-established prior UID and low half in IfuAgent.
implementation.event_contract: The13 Ifu.perfEvents are modeled as Boolean event classifications from accepted fetch metadata and actual IBuffer fire, with ICachePerfInfo single/double-line hit/miss truth table and the public HasPerfEvents two-register latency. All13 fields are checked in both continuous DriveStable and RisingEdge snapshots.
implementation.lifecycle_contract: Offer, physical fire, same-slot cancellation, stage movement, child uncache acceptance, actual bus issue, explicit peer reply, enqueue, redirect, resend, cancel and finish tail remain separate input-UID records. Same-slot bus/reply plus redirect, live FTQ age, carry cancellation, no-issue/no-reply watchdog, duplicate/missing channel and swallowed-error controls use the production agent.
implementation.provenance: FetchRequest is port-characterization; ProducerFetchRequest adds audited DefaultConfig extent/page/FTQ successor/translation-offset/age constraints. Input and peer source are carried separately and cannot promote a port-only carry or fake resend.
implementation.static_audit: IFU feature call chains contain zero pin expressions, signal operations or native access files under the strict transaction-boundary audit; this is not used as the only semantic evidence.
implementation.build: No RTL/native rebuild. Existing seven cache build receipts, build IDs and actual native inputs remain unchanged and match the previous checkpoint.
